notes.title: Upcoming Beta Testing
notes.content:
Hello Team! Today we are excited to share information about our upcoming beta test. This beta test will be closed to the general public and must fill out an application. Those who are accepted will have access to the game early and test it. The test will include the following:

 General Improvement Suggestions
 Bug Reporting
 General Playtest

While this list is small, it is only to see what can be added to the game to fit our players wants and needs. We listen to all of our players feedback. Currently, what are some things you want to see in our MMO RPG game? Let us know down below in the comments.

How To Sign Up
To sign up to beta test please fill out our application [Link Below]. There are also requirements so please read those first. (NOTE: Not All Applicants will be accepted due to the small amount of testers we currently need.

When Will Beta Test Start?
Beta Testing will start sometime in October towards the end. We will email everyone who got accepted with details as they will be given a steam key.
